name: Renovate Migration Cleanup

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Run weekly on Monday at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  github-actions-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update GitHub Actions
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-runtime@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update GitHub Actions versions"
          title: "chore: update GitHub Actions versions"
          body: |
            Automated update of GitHub Actions versions.
          branch: "renovate/github-actions"
          base: main
          labels: |
            dependencies
            github-actions

  general-js-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: js/deps_updater

      - name: Update JS dependencies
        run: pnpm run update
        working-directory: js/deps_updater

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update JavaScript dependencies"
          title: "chore: update JavaScript dependencies"
          body: |
            Automated update of JavaScript/pnpm dependencies.
          branch: "renovate/js-deps"
          base: main
          labels: |
            dependencies
            javascript
